title: Whole Swollen Trunk and High Fork Dry Tree
description: One entirely newly authored stylised dry bottle-trunk tree. A low irregular flared foot grows into a massive asymmetric swollen barrel trunk, then contracts through rounded high shoulders into a short high branching crown. Thick crooked high limbs spread widely then turn upward, each with tapered returning terminal forks; there is no foliage canopy hiding the fork spaces. The trunk profile, crooked limb paths and complete silhouette are new, not a widened old umbrella trunk, changed leaf count or extracted root stump. Compared with the old narrow tapered umbrella trunk and its connected broad green crown, and the low riverbank fork with a long leaning leader and two green crown masses, this is a complete high-shouldered swollen-trunk dry-tree form. One model zero scenes. Coarse stylised environmental tree only, not exact baobab taxonomy, living growth, wood mechanics, ecology or safety. Rig animation interaction not made.
